in_hebrew.name: Håkon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Håkon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Norse name Hákon, meaning 'high son' or 'he who reigns high'. This name was popular among Norwegian kings, including Håkon the Good and Håkon Haakonsson.

in_greek.name: Håkon
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει High son
in_greek.long_meaning: Håkon είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old Norse name Hákon, meaning 'high son' or 'he who reigns high'. This name was popular among Norwegian kings, including Håkon the Good and Håkon Haakonsson.

in_latin.name: Hacōn
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Hacōn derivatum est ab verbo hac, significans altum, et verbo cōn, significans ducem, ergo nomen Hacōn portat significatum ducis alti vel nobilis
